notes: Frozen from this suite's study.json and agents.json at 1 run per participant (configurations with their own run count keep it), exactly as Freeze & campaigns → Freeze campaign freezes them, with a fixed ID and date so every machine gets the same campaign.
Installed into campaigns/ when the study opens with no campaign yet (and by node scripts/setup.mjs); deleting it does not bring it back. Freeze another campaign at any time.
Simulate works for every configuration at no cost. Real sessions (Mode: Run agents) use your Claude Code login: start with one session (Run this session only).

The configurations that use the app (C, C-Dem, D, D-Dem, U1, UD, UDO, UDOT, UDOT-full, UDOT-full-reason) need an Unreal study bridge in Settings → Runtimes; until one is set they can only be simulated. The app-free ones (A, A-Dem, B, B-Dem, F, F-Dem) run as real sessions on any machine with Claude Code.
rebuild: npm run starters (after changing the suite's study.json, agents.json, workspace.json or a source file)
